ordinal_diagnostics.warning: Constant-zero pairs satisfy ordering vacuously and provide no ordinal learnability evidence.

interpretation.structural_zero_operational_definition: No positive case at the earliest archived physical support stages (fragment hit, penetration, deposited energy) for the components used by a task/category under this fixed archive and design measure.
interpretation.rare_positive_operational_definition: Positive upstream support exists but occupies a small fraction of the current design measure, so prevalence and metric estimates have substantial finite-sample uncertainty.
interpretation.threshold_induced_zero_operational_defin: Positive continuous upstream dose exists but a downstream state threshold or damage-tree gate maps it to zero; this requires paired dose/gate evidence and must not be inferred from a zero label alone.
findings: K and C old system outputs are constant zero and unlearnable; C also has zero candidate-category hit/penetration/energy support in all 5000 archived cases.
F has only 28 candidate-category upstream-positive cases, all through the narrow observed component support; this is rare positive support rather than a universal impossibility claim.
M has broad upstream support, while current M1/M2 outputs are not an admissible nested ordinal pair if M2 is intended as level 2.
Every case uses one orientation and one normalized velocity direction. The archive cannot identify directional/attitude effects or justify generalization beyond this fixed approach geometry.
R=2 restricts direct Bernoulli probability resolution to 0, 0.5 and 1 and makes nondetection indistinguishable from a truly zero conditional probability without a convergence experiment.

deep_learning_implications.recommendation: Do not train or report K/C heads from this archive. Treat F as a separate rare-event/hurdle task only after acquiring substantially more independent positive cases in Train. Preserve a reference stream and keep outcome-enriched sampling weights separate from minibatch/task weights.

scientific_boundary: All Train, Validation, and previously observed Test rows are included. Results are descriptive diagnostics of one unvalidated synthetic archive and fixed design distribution. They do not establish real-world prevalence, physical validity, or causal inevitability of sparsity.
